setup_body: Messages of up to 10 characters, end-to-end encrypted. Choose how the app connects, then create a passphrase.
fallback_detail: Used when the main relay cannot be reached
setup_relays_note: Both devices need at least one relay in common. You can change this later in Settings.
setup_pass_hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.
setup_pass_warning: There is no recovery. If you forget the passphrase, the conversation is gone.
setup_err_failed: Could not save the keys on this device.
reset_body: The old conversation could not be opened and was removed. Create a passphrase to start again.
gate_body: Enter your passphrase to open your conversation.
pair_body: Make a one-time code and share it with one person, or type the code they gave you.
notice_mismatch: The numbers did not match. The conversation was removed.
notice_timeout: No device answered with that code.
notice_tampered: The relays gave different answers, or the other side's keys did not match. Pairing was cancelled.
notice_full: That code has already been used by two devices.
notice_storage: Could not save the keys on this device.
waiting_body: Type this code on the other device within 24 hours. Share it only with that person.
joining_body: Checking the code and finding the other device. This can take up to a minute.
verify_body: Both devices must show the same number. Compare it by voice or in person, not by message through this app. This check is what protects you against a malicious relay.
chat_empty: No messages yet. Say something in 10 characters or fewer.
chat_offline: Offline. Messages will send when a relay can be reached.
chat_gone: The relays no longer have this conversation. You may need to pair again.
chat_limit_bytes: No more room. Some letters take extra space.
relay_change_note: Changing relays applies to new pairings only.
relay_body: Both devices must use the same relay. Only https addresses are accepted.
forget_confirm_body: The keys and messages are deleted from this device. You would need to pair again.
settings_notifications_detail: Only says that a message arrived
about_intro: TenChar is a two-person messenger. Every message is 10 characters or fewer, padded to one size and end-to-end encrypted. There are no accounts, phone numbers, names or analytics.
about_status: The desktop app speaks the same protocol as the Android app, through the same relays.
about_review: The handshake and the ratchet have not been reviewed by an independent expert. Do not rely on this app where a flaw could cause serious harm.
about_not_title: What it does not protect against
about_not_1: Relays can see your IP address, when you send, and the fixed size of each message.
about_not_2: Malware running as your user can read memory and keystrokes.
about_not_3: The operating system may write memory to disk (swap, hibernation).
about_not_4: A weak passphrase can be guessed by someone who copies the data file.
about_not_5: Hiding the window from screen capture works only on some systems, and a camera defeats it.
about_not_6: If both devices of a pairing are compromised at once, the conversation is exposed.
about_not_7: A pairing joins exactly two devices. Your phone and your desktop need separate pairings.
keys_reset_body: The saved conversation could not be opened, so it was removed. This cannot be undone.
